name: print-social-digimarkt-bring-your-brand-to-life-poster-pink-blue
title: 'Bring Your Brand To Life' poster in pink and blue with a framed desk photo and stacked 3D-shadow type
whatItIs: A pink-bordered blue poster with a white-framed desk photo (hands typing beside charts and a compass), a small sign-up URL line, giant white condensed headline 'BRING YOUR BRAND TO LIFE' with a blue drop shadow on each letter, a tagline 'Crafting Digital Journeys', topographic contour-line art and a paper-plane logo.
whatItMeans: Energetic and confident; the layered shadow type gives a simple poster real punch without extra imagery.
techniques: Give headline type a offset colour shadow for a 3D pop.
Frame a supporting photo in a clean white border.
Add topographic contour lines as light background texture.

vocabulary.definition: Lettering with an offset colour shadow for a layered, 3D look.
Thin curved lines resembling a topographic map.
